# Vendored nanopb runtime (0.4.9.1), version-matched to the committed
# home_controller.pb.c/.pb.h (generated by the nanopb 0.4.9.1 generator).
# Vendored rather than pulled from the component registry because there is no
# official "nanopb/nanopb" registry component -- only third-party forks -- and
# pinning the runtime to the exact generator version guarantees the
# PB_PROTO_HEADER_VERSION (40) match. See proto/home_controller.proto.
idf_component_register(
    SRCS
        "pb_common.c"
        "pb_encode.c"
        "pb_decode.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "."
)
